messages:
hao: started a small docs PR to reconcile Optimize toolkit wording around batching vs prefetch. includes migration tips and a concise SDK snippet: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4333
mina: good, can you call out the runtime default prefetch (500ms) — readers were confused by the previous wording.
raj: SDK param name differs on main (`prefetch_window_ms`). add an alias note or update snippet.
lina: found a stale external gist link in the samples list. i'll submit a tiny link-fix and point to /examples/optimize instead.
docs-bot: CI: docs build queued for PR #4333
mina: sample SDK snippet copied here for quick review: ```python
from redwood import OptimizeClient
client = OptimizeClient(prefetch_window_ms=500, kv_cache_enabled=True)
```
hao: updated in PR to use `prefetch_window_ms`. also added a one-paragraph migration note and a short p95/p50 benchmark table for short vs long sequences.
raj: +1 pending link-fix and CI. please add a one-line callout that heavy quantization can reduce KV hit rates.
lina: link-fix merged, CI green. :white_check_mark:
docs-bot: CI: docs build success for PR #4333  warnings, 0 errors
mina: will review and merge after small wording tweak. thanks team!
